set.body:
Define a versioned renderer-neutral scene/state document for reproducible scientific figures and application handoff. Serialize surface asset references and digests, topology identity, surface kind/hemisphere, layer ids/order/visibility/encoding/thresholds, camera/viewpoint, bilateral arrangement, lighting, clipping, selected vertex/timepoint, backend-neutral capability requirements, and provenance. Keep large geometry and field payloads external by stable references unless an explicit embedded form is selected.

Acceptance: canonical roundtrip is deterministic on JVM and Scala.js; unknown future fields are handled by an explicit version policy; invalid or mismatched asset identities fail with typed diagnostics; serialized state reproduces reference-renderer semantic receipts and canonical camera projections; no JavaFX or Three.js implementation detail appears in the schema.
set.title: Surface viewer state, provenance, and reproducible scene serialization
